prior_year_events.impact_description: The LPT reinsured 2021 & prior underwriting year business (effective 30 June 2023) which materially affected reinsurance recoverables and the prior year reserve run-off.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 64.719m in 2024 (a reduction in gross prior year reserves), driven by favourable claims development and an increase in reinsurers' recoverables (the reinsurers' share increased by GBP 35.639m). The Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) effected in June 2023 (covering 2021 & prior years) materially affected reinsurance recoverables and interpretation of prior year movement. The largest movements by class were increases in reinsurance acceptances and casualty reserves, offset by releases in some direct lines such as fire and assistance.
raw_causal_phrases:
Change in estimates of prior year
provisions (64,719) 35,639 (29,080) (12,238) (101,441) (113,679)

The Loss Portfolio Transfer ("LPT"), a reinsurance for 2021 & prior underwriting year, became effective at 30th June 2023. This resulted in all 2021 & prior underwriting year business (excluding Space policies and a single Casualty policy) being reinsured to a limit of 130% of the ceded reserves.
In arriving at the level of claims provisions a margin is applied over and above the actuarial best estimate, which reduces the possibility of adverse claims development during run-off.

Claims Inflation
In light of the elevated level of general inflation seen since late 2021, the Syndicate has considered whether this may lead to an increase in claims inflation. ... As at year end on a net of reinsurance (including net of LPT) basis, a loading of GBP 0.9m is being held in respect of excess claims inflation within the Syndicate loss reserves.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) taken from Note 17 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross column). The LPT (effective 30 June 2023) affects interpretation because it reinsured 2021 & prior business and increased reinsurers' share; net and gross movements differ materially (gross release GBP 64.719m vs net release GBP 29.080m). Some statutory classes (e.g. 'Assistance', 'Credit and suretyship') do not map cleanly to the provided standard Lloyd's LOB list; mapping for lob_movements focused on major classes only.
